Package com.nexuslink.protocol.mqtt

package com.nexuslink.protocol.mqtt
  • Class
    Description
    MqttBrokerUri
    A pure, dependency-free parser for the broker connection URIs an MQTT client connects with, of the general form scheme://[user[:password]@]host[:port][/path].
    MqttBrokerUriException
    Thrown by MqttBrokerUri.parse(String) when a broker connection URI is malformed — an unknown scheme, a missing host, an out-of-range or non-numeric port, or bad percent-encoding.
    MqttCodeGenerator
    Renders an MQTT publish/subscribe snippet — the MQTT side of the cross-protocol code-generation SPI.
    MqttCodeGenerator.Request
    What to generate for.
    MqttHistoryEntry
    One line of MQTT message history: a message that was received from, or published to, a broker.
    MqttHistoryEntry.Direction
    Which way the message travelled relative to this client.
    MqttHistoryStore
    The on-disk half of the MQTT message history: an append-only, line-per-entry file that survives restarts.
    MqttMessageHistory
    A bounded, in-memory log of MqttHistoryEntry — the model behind the MQTT view's message list.
    MqttMessageProperties
    The MQTT 5.0 message properties this client models as first-class fields, decoupled from the Eclipse Paho types so both publish and received paths can carry them and they can be unit-tested without a broker.
    MqttMessageProperties.UserProperty
    A single MQTT 5.0 user property: an arbitrary UTF-8 name/value pair (both required).
    MqttService
    MQTT client wrapper over Eclipse Paho (MQTT v5.0).
    MqttService.Incoming
    A received message, decoupled from Paho types for the UI, with its MQTT 5.0 properties.
    MqttService.MessageListener
    Subscription stream callbacks (invoked off the UI thread, on Paho's MQTT thread).
    MqttTopicFilter
    A pure, dependency-free implementation of MQTT topic matching and topic/filter validation as specified by MQTT 3.1.1 and MQTT 5.0, section 4.7 ("Topic Names and Topic Filters").

NexusLink — one console, every protocol, zero context switching.
